rule.text: The first paragraph gives a reader who opened this in an inbox a reason to keep reading before any context is supplied.

constraints.note: whether the opening earns the scroll; a heading is not a hook

rule.text: The piece ends once, with a close the reader can act on or sit with, not a second summary.

delivery_notes: Read in an email client, on a phone as often as not, in one sitting or abandoned. Paragraphs longer than a phone screen lose readers who would have finished on a desktop. Links are fine in the body; a link is not a hook. The subject line is not part of the piece and is not reviewed here.
